title: MetaDescriptor
summary: One metadata record rendered by Meta.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body: A record of metadata properties. A string title renders a title element. A script:ld+json field renders safely serialized JSON-LD. tagName: "link" renders a link; other records render a meta element.

sections.title: Usage and limits
sections.body: MetaDescriptor is a broad record type rather than a strict HTML schema. Supply valid element attributes. JSON-LD is serialized as JSON data; do not provide an already stringified script body.
